defs.def: dislike of or opposition to a plan, an idea, etc; refusal to obey 反对；抵制；抗拒

ex.s: The resistance to vaccine has continued for decades, and it is driven by a real but very small risk.
ex.t: 少量的麻疹病例可能引发危险的趋势

defs.def: the act of using force to oppose sb/sth 抵抗；反抗

ex.s: Cold-causing viruses are not only of kinds, they also rapidly, meaning they can quickly develop resistance to medicine.
ex.t: 引起感冒的病毒不仅种类繁多，它们还迅速______，这意味着它们能迅速对药物产生耐药性。

ex.s: One day soon we will be able to use genome editing to increase the human resistance to colds and flus, to make people taller more intelligent.
ex.t: 不久的将来，我们将能够使用基因编辑来提高人类对感冒和流感的抵抗力，使人们更高更聪明。

defs.def: the power not to be affected by sth 抗力；抵抗力
a force that stops sth moving or makes it move more slowly 阻力
the opposition of a substance or device to the flow of an electrical current 电阻
a secret organization that resists the authorities, especially in a country that an enemy has control of （尤指敌占区的）秘密抵抗组织
